text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she darts across the turf, golden hair
ablaze in the sunset, Gold
City's face is
the picture of determination.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And... done! Pant, pant... My time! What's my time?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Really? ...Wow, it actually is. I... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, do you have to be so extra all the time? But yeah... I guess I am amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. You're over the top, and annoying, and tactless, and you really piss me off sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But you know, being a trainer really fits
you. Maybe it's like, your
calling, or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you better not let that get to your
head, though. You haven't
earned my full
approval yet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That there is exactly what I'm talking about! Ahaha! All right, time to hit up the gym for the rest of the evening. It's leg day after all...

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Manager? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt practice, but it's an
emergency! This could be your
big break!

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! I'm going to have to cut
practice short today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wha—Who made you boss? We've still got tons to work on!

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Please, just hear me out. This will affect
your future!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: My future?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, turns out, I was just a substitute. Some
hotshot model canceled
last minute, so I
was called to fill in.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I got the job done, obviously. I always give
one hundred-percent, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But then my manager said I gave a "safe
and bland performance."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it was a pretty big deal, even if I was
just a sub. My big chance
to get noticed
by all these superstar names.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I get where she's coming from, but like,
can she not take away from
my training
time? And get this—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's like, "Ever since you started hanging
around that trainer, you've
been losing
sight of your priorities as a model."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Like, I'm sorry, what?! Anyway, it got ugly.
Ugh, what a disaster.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know she's right. I haven't been
as focused on work. Hard to
care about
poses when all I can think about is running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thing is, I promised to keep modeling so
she'd let me enroll here.
Managed to
convince her I could do both.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But now that I'm actually getting serious
about racing, well... Not
exactly what I
hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I could run two roads at
once, but guess I just don't
have that kind
of agility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She falls silent, but her brooding
expression tells me her thoughts are
still
racing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer... You somehow knew I'd make
a decent runner, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You knew I wasn't just some pretty
doll—that I could win out there on
the
turf... And you still believe that, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Hah... Okay, I've decided. Honestly
don't know why I didn't do
this earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What are you imagining? Relax, geez. If
anything, it might be good
news for you.
Because I...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Am going to quit modeling!
